Team,

This is the final forecast flush for EMEA & APAC ahead of finance cutoff tomorrow EOD. Action items by 3pm local tomorrow (Wed):

- Mark any true-commit opportunities as Closed/Won in SFDC and set the final close date (no placeholder dates).
- For anything you expect to close within Q3 but are not a firm commit, set Stage = Negotiation and flag risk in the attached rollup.
- Update owner and ARR in the spreadsheet attached (tab: OWNER_UPDATES).
- If any deal needs a PO or procurement step, loop in the contact in this thread and paste expected PO date.

I attached the EMEA_Q3_commit_spreadsheet.xlsx and a short risk rollup (regional_risk_rollup.pdf). I'm asking for a clean slate so Revenue Ops can reconcile tomorrow morning.

Callouts:
- Large enterprise deals (>$200k ARR) — please ping me directly if you need a one-hour cert call before finance cut.
- Any cross-border billing (APAC adopting EMEA rates) — include Finance in the comment column.

Attachments: [Attachment: EMEA_Q3_commit_spreadsheet.xlsx (spreadsheet)] [Attachment: regional_risk_rollup.pdf (pdf)]

Thanks — runbooks below and I will circulate the consolidated pack once I get your updates.

Jonas
